text_en: When morning came, all the chief priests and the elders of the people conferred together against Jesus in order to bring about his death.
text_cn: 到了早晨，众司祭长和民间的长老就决议陷害耶稣，要把他处死，

text_en: They bound him, led him away, and handed him over to Pilate the governor.
text_cn: 遂把他捆绑了，解送给总督比拉多。

text_en: When Judas, his betrayer, saw that Jesus was condemned, he repented and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders.
text_cn: 这时，那出卖耶稣的犹达斯见他已被判决，就后悔了，把那三十块银钱，退还给司祭长和长老，

text_en: He said, “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood. ” But they said, “What is that to us? See to it yourself. ”
text_cn: 说：“我出卖了无辜的血，犯了罪了！”他们却说：“这与我们何干？是你自己的事！”

text_en: Throwing down the pieces of silver in the temple, he departed; and he went and hanged himself.
text_cn: 于是他把那些银钱扔在圣所里，就退出来，上吊死了。

text_en: But the chief priests, taking the pieces of silver, said, “It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, since they are blood money. ”
text_cn: 司祭长拿了那些银钱说：“这是血价，不可放入献仪箱内。”

text_en: After conferring together, they used them to buy the potter’s field as a place to bury foreigners.
text_cn: 他们商议后，就用那银钱买了陶工的田地，作为埋葬外乡人用。

text_en: For this reason that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
text_cn: 为此，直到今日称那块田地为“血田”。

text_en: Then was fulfilled what had been spoken through the prophet Jeremiah, “And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of the one on whom a price had been set, on whom some of the people of Israel had set a price,
text_cn: 这就应验了耶肋米亚先知所说的话：“他们拿了三十块银钱，即以色列子民为被卖的人所估定的价钱，

text_en: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me. ”
text_cn: 用这钱买了陶工的那块田，如上主所吩咐我的。”

text_en: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews? ” Jesus said, “You say so. ”
text_cn: 耶稣站在总督面前，总督便审问他说：“你是犹太人的君王吗？”耶稣答说：“你说的是。”

text_en: But when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he did not answer.
text_cn: 当司祭长和长老控告他时，他什么也不回答。

text_en: Then Pilate said to him, “Do you not hear how many accusations they make against you? ”
text_cn: 于是比拉多对他说：“你没有听见，他们提出多少证据告你吗？”

text_en: But he gave him no answer, not even to a single charge, so that the governor was greatly amazed.
text_cn: 耶稣连一句话也没有回答他，以致总督大为惊异。

text_en: Now at the festival the governor was accustomed to release a prisoner for the crowd, anyone whom they wanted.
text_cn: 每逢节日，总督惯常给民众释放一个他们愿意释放的囚犯。

text_en: At that time they had a notorious prisoner, called Jesus Barabbas.
text_cn: 那时，正有一个出名的囚犯，名叫巴辣巴。

text_en: So after they had gathered, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release for you, Jesus Barabbas or Jesus who is called the Messiah? ”
text_cn: 当他们聚集在一起时，比拉多对他们说：“你们愿意我给你们释放哪一个？巴辣巴，或是那称为默西亚的耶稣？”

text_en: For he realized that it was out of jealousy that they had handed him over.
text_cn: 原来他知道，他们是由于嫉妒才把他解送来的。

text_en: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent word to him, “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for today I have suffered a great deal because of a dream about him. ”
text_cn: 比拉多正坐堂时，他的妻子差人到他跟前说：“你千万不要干涉那义人的事，因为我为他，今天在梦中受了许多苦。”

text_en: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus killed.
text_cn: 司祭长和长老却说服了民众，叫他们要求巴辣巴，而除掉耶稣。

text_en: The governor again said to them, “Which of the two do you want me to release for you? ” And they said, “Barabbas. ”
text_cn: 总督又向他们发言说：“这两个人中，你们愿意我给你们释放那一个？”他们说：“巴辣巴。”

text_en: Pilate said to them, “Then what should I do with Jesus who is called the Messiah? ” All of them said, “Let him be crucified! ”
text_cn: 比拉多对他们说：“那么，对于那称为默西亚的耶稣我该怎么办？”众人答说：“该钉他在十字架上。”

text_en: Then he asked, “Why, what evil has he done? ” But they shouted all the more, “Let him be crucified! ”
text_cn: 总督问说：“他究竟作了什么恶事？”他们越发喊说：“该钉他在十字架上。”

text_en: So when Pilate saw that he could do nothing, but rather that a riot was beginning, he took some water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, “I am innocent of this man’s blood; see to it yourselves. ”
text_cn: 比拉多见事毫无进展，反倒更为混乱，就拿水，当着民众洗手说：“对这义人的血，我是无罪的，你们自己负责吧！”

text_en: Then the people as a whole answered, “His blood be on us and on our children! ”
text_cn: 全体百姓回答说：“他的血归在我们和我们的子孙身上！”

text_en: So he released Barabbas for them; and after flogging Jesus, he handed him over to be crucified.
text_cn: 于是，比拉多给他们释放了巴辣巴；至于耶稣，把他鞭打了以后，交给人钉在十字架上。

text_en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the governor’s headquarters, and they gathered the whole cohort around him.
text_cn: 那时，总督的兵士把耶稣带到总督府内，召集了全队围着他，

text_en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
text_cn: 脱去了他的衣服，给他披上一件紫红色的外氅（chǎng）；

text_en: and after twisting some thorns into a crown, they put it on his head. They put a reed in his right hand and knelt before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews! ”
text_cn: 又用荆棘编了一个茨冠，戴在他头上，拿一根芦苇放在他右手里；然后跪在他前，戏弄他说：“犹太人的君王，万岁！”

text_en: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
text_cn: 随后向他吐唾沫，拿起芦苇来敲他的头。

text_en: After mocking him, they stripped him of the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.
text_cn: 戏弄完了，就给他脱去外氅，又给他穿上他自己的衣服，带他去钉在十字架上。

text_en: As they went out, they came upon a man from Cyrene named Simon; they compelled this man to carry his cross.
text_cn: 他们出来时，遇见一个基勒乃人，名叫西满，就强迫他背耶稣的十字架。

text_en: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (which means Place of a Skull),
text_cn: 到了一个名叫哥耳哥达的地方，即称为“髑（dú）髅（lóu）”的地方，

text_en: they offered him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but when he tasted it, he would not drink it.
text_cn: 他们就拿苦艾调和的酒给他喝；他只尝了尝，却不愿意喝。

text_en: And when they had crucified him, they divided his clothes among themselves by casting lots;
text_cn: 他们把他钉在十字架上以后，就拈（niān)阄(jiū)分了他的衣服；

text_en: then they sat down there and kept watch over him.
text_cn: 然后坐在那里看守他。

text_en: Over his head they put the charge against him, which read, “This is Jesus, the King of the Jews. ”
text_cn: 在他的头上安放了他的罪状牌，写着说：“这是耶稣，犹太人的君王。”

text_en: Then two bandits were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
text_cn: 当时与他一起被钉在十字架上的，还有两个强盗：一个在右边，一个在左边。

text_en: Those who passed by derided him, shaking their heads
text_cn: 路过的人都摇头辱骂他说：

text_en: and saying, “You who would destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross. ”
text_cn: “你这拆毁圣殿而三日内重建起来的，救你自己吧！如果你是天主子，从十字架上下来吧！”

text_en: In the same way the chief priests also, along with the scribes and elders, were mocking him, saying,
text_cn: 司祭长和经师与长老们也同样戏弄说：

text_en: “He saved others; he cannot save himself. He is the King of Israel; let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
text_cn: “他救了别人，却救不了自己；他既是以色列君王：如今从十字架上下来吧！我们就信他。

text_en: He trusts in God; let God deliver him now, if he wants to; for he said, ‘I am God’s Son. ’”
text_cn: 他信赖天主，天主如喜欢他，如今就该救他，因为他说过：我是天主子。”

text_en: The bandits who were crucified with him also taunted him in the same way.
text_cn: 同他一起被钉在十字架上的强盗，也这样讥诮(qiào)他。

text_en: From noon on, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
text_cn: 从第六时辰起，直到第九时辰，遍地都黑暗了。

text_en: And about three o’clock Jesus cried with a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? ” that is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? ”
text_cn: 约莫第九时辰，耶稣大声喊说：“厄里、厄里，肋玛撒巴黑塔尼！”就是说：“我的天主，我的天主！你为什么舍弃了我？”

text_en: When some of the bystanders heard it, they said, “This man is calling for Elijah. ”
text_cn: 站在那里的人中，有几个听见了就说：“这人呼唤厄里亚呢！”

text_en: At once one of them ran and got a sponge, filled it with sour wine, put it on a stick, and gave it to him to drink.
text_cn: 他们中遂有一个立即跑去，拿了海绵，浸满了醋，绑在芦苇上，递给他喝。

text_en: But the others said, “Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him. ”
text_cn: 其余的人却说：“等一等，我们看，是否厄里亚来救他！”

text_en: Then Jesus cried again with a loud voice and breathed his last.
text_cn: 耶稣又大喊一声，遂交付了灵魂。

text_en: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. The earth shook, and the rocks were split.
text_cn: 看圣所的帐幔，从上到下分裂为二， 大地震动，岩石崩裂，

text_en: The tombs also were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
text_cn: 坟墓自开，许多长眠的圣者的身体复活了。

text_en: After his resurrection they came out of the tombs and entered the holy city and appeared to many.
text_cn: 在耶稣复活后，他们由坟墓出来，进入圣城，发显给许多人。

text_en: Now when the centurion and those with him, who were keeping watch over Jesus, saw the earthquake and what took place, they were terrified and said, “Truly this man was God’s Son! ”
text_cn: 百夫长和同他一起看守耶稣的人，一见地动和所发生的事，就非常害怕说：“这人真是天主子！”

text_en: Many women were also there, looking on from a distance; they had followed Jesus from Galilee and had provided for him.
text_cn: 有许多妇女在那里从远处观望，她们从加里肋亚就跟随了耶稣为服事他。

text_en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
text_cn: 其中有玛利亚玛达肋纳，雅各伯和若瑟的母亲玛利亚与载伯德儿子的母亲。

text_en: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who was also a disciple of Jesus.
text_cn: 到了傍晚，来了一个阿黎玛特雅的富人，名叫若瑟，他也是耶稣的门徒。

text_en: He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus; then Pilate ordered it to be given to him.
text_cn: 这人去见比拉多请求耶稣的遗体；比拉多就下令交给他。

text_en: So Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
text_cn: 若瑟领了耶稣的遗体，就用洁白的殓布将它包好，

text_en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn in the rock. He then rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb and went away.
text_cn: 安放在为自己于岩石间所凿的新墓穴内；并把一块大石头滚到墓口，就走了。

text_en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.
text_cn: 在那里还有玛利亚玛达肋纳和另外一个玛利亚，对着坟墓坐着。

text_en: The next day, that is, after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate
text_cn: 第二天，即预备日以后的那天，司祭长和法利塞人同来见比拉多说：

text_en: and said, “Sir, we remember what that impostor said while he was still alive, ‘After three days I will rise again. ’
text_cn: “大人，我们记得那个骗子活着的时候曾说过：三天以后我要复活。

text_en: Therefore command the tomb to be made secure until the third day; otherwise his disciples may go and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He has been raised from the dead, ’ and the last deception would be worse than the first. ”
text_cn: 为此，请你下令，把守坟墓直到第三天；怕他的门徒来了，把他偷去，而对百姓说：他从死人中复活了。那最后的骗局就比先前的更坏了！”

text_en: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard of soldiers; go, make it as secure as you can. ”
text_cn: 比拉多对他们说：“你们可得一队卫兵；你们去，照你们所知道的，好好看守。”

text_en: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone.
text_cn: 他们就去，在石上加了封条，派驻卫兵把守坟墓。
